remarks: Welcome to 35 Treehaven Rd. in West Seneca! This beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers 1,734 sq. ft. of comfortable living space and wonderful curb appeal. Step inside to find gleaming hardwood floors and a bright, spacious living room with a large front window that fills the space with natural light. The fully updated kitchen is a standout, featuring abundant cabinetry and counter space, a generous center island with seating, and plenty of room for gathering and entertaining. All appliances included as well.  A separate formal dining room with built-in bookcases adds character and versatility. Lovely 1/2 bath finishes the first floor.  On the 2nd floor you will find Four bedrooms. Each is generous in size and provides plenty of space.  The full basement offers excellent storage and additional possibilities. Updated furnace and hot water tank and electrical panel. Sump pump has water powered backup for peace of mind. Outside, enjoy the beautifully maintained yard with plenty of room for outdoor entertaining, gardening, or simply relaxing, plus a convenient storage shed. A 2.5-car attached garage provides exceptional parking and storage space. 35 Treehaven Rd. is ready to welcome its next owner. Don't miss the opportunity to make this wonderful West Seneca home your own! Showings begin Wednesday September 30th. Open House Saturday October 3rd 11-1pm
